cc:Work.dc:title: Pigeons on wires
cc:Work.dc:description: This was created as Vinyl wall graphics for my studio. There is a huge tree next to my studio that is home for these pigeons and they are all over my studio. I can't clean the crap everyday, so I figured I might as well put up vinyl pigeons so people can relate to all that poop. Drawn using inkscape by pencilsauce.com
